PHASE-5 RESIDUAL-GAP DISPOSITION SWEEP (epic cf3c-1444-863e-49d7), before epic close.

Enumerated gap sources across the run and their dispositions:
1. cb91-1535-fe3a-47fc (generalize the self-contained 2-parent fold into a shared reconcile_one; discovered_from 0289) — FILED (open).
2. 2207-2917-e21b-42bd (py3.11 opcert xdist worker-crash flake on test_matching_guard_is_accepted; discovered_from b014) — FILED (open). DEFINITIVELY proven base-wide/nondeterministic and independent of these changes: base sha 2d440ad668 itself crashes ~1/3 of runs identically and passes ~1/3; docs-only changes cannot affect opcert collection. Cleared by recheck.
3. b014 review-plan advisories — NONE (final PASS had 0 advisory).
4. Change 1552 (docs) LLM-Review advisories (PS1x1, PS2x2, non-blocking) — ACCEPTED: non-blocking advisories on a documentation-only change that merged LLM-Review+1 AND Verified+1; no behavioral surface.
5. Change 1555 (docs) LLM-Review advisories — NONE.
6. 0289 (change 1550, prior sessions) advisories (PS1x8, PS5x2, non-blocking) — ACCEPTED as non-blocking on merged code; the one substantive generalization gap is FILED as cb91.
7. 4a surface-parity census — the S3 backend operation surface was delivered by the code stories (2b05/8970/0289) via the store/push/doctor seam and covered by their held-out oracles; b014 is a docs leaf introducing NO new operation surface -> N/A for b014.
8. 4b excluded tests / 4e-bis escalation compromises — NONE (b014 is a non-code docs leaf; no implementer subagent, no held-out oracle).
9. Landing-time deviation: ADR 0092->0093 renumber (collision with landed 0092-bridge ADR) — FIXED IN SCOPE (delivered as 0093 + delivery note in b014 description).
10. Upstream git-remote-s3 README documents a stale lock-TTL env var (GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL); code reads GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS (verified against v0.3.2 tarball, tag=commit 9f3290e1, remote.py:95; the stale string appears in NO .py file) — FIXED IN SCOPE (flagged in docs + ADR with commit permalink and a verify-your-version hedge via change 1555).

No enumerated gap left without a disposition. Proceeding to close epic cf3c.
